## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Justification: very weak sector breadth plus narrow leadership (Top 5 concentrated in Technology/Utilities), and broad sector weakness (9/11 sectors negative) — conflicting signals warrant caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +33.76%) ABOVE TREND. Technology pockets are strong: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -15.91%) BELOW TREND, other cyclical names under pressure; Technology overall mixed with many large-cap softening despite pockets of strength.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -11.82% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.24% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -15.91%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software and select healthcare/consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +10.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND. Note a MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (AAPL, NOW, V, MA showing 1W/1M disagreement) — treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, patchy leadership inside weakness; NVDA (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing internal rotation: pockets of AI/semis and legacy software divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft-to-mixed: JPM (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.83% | 1M: +1.88%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +1.41%) CORRECTION. Lack of broad strength in Financials keeps them neutral-to-weak in this caution regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure overall: AMGN (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +4.32%) ABOVE TREND — defensive names mixed but overall sector 1W underperformance.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor taking exposure to selective Utilities and Energy leaders (VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +28.34%) ABOVE TREND) and technology names showing confirmed leadership (INTC, ORCL, META) while reducing exposure to high-multiple software and weak healthcare names (ADBE, NOW, SYK) showing steep pullbacks. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — remain selective and manage position size given narrow leadership and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to monitor; ORCL (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +10.54%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/guide follow-through. BEARISH: SYK (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -3.00%) BELOW TREND — risk of continued downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +1.09%) — leadership confirming flows; Energy (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +16.22%) — cyclical strength. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -0.44%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -7.34%) — watch for further weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND — weekly close above last week’s high would confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — failure to reclaim the monthly uptrend risks deeper pullback. META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND — sustainment above recent breakout is key for momentum. MSFT (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND — break below 1M support would confirm broader large-cap unwind.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+80): Nvidia earnings blowout; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +0.79%) — sentiment confirming price strength. (Other bullish headlines concentrated in Utilities and select tech names supporting sector pockets but breadth remains weak.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-85): Major settlement headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) — notable divergence between negative headlines and price strength, monitor for distribution. MSFT (-50): legal headwinds; price BELOW TREND (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -1.02%) — sentiment confirming softness. SYK (-45): supply-chain hit; price BELOW TREND (1W: -14.63% | 1M: -18.46%) — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +2.77%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.45% | 1M: +7.92%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-caps (multiple big names in CORRECTION or showing 1W/1M discord) and negative headlines on META/MSFT — monitor sentiment-price divergences before expanding risk.
